market_question: Fed rate cut by September 2026 meeting?
reasoning: The Fed's December 2024 dot plot shows a median rate of 3.1% by end-2026, implying additional cuts after 2025. The window from Dec 2025 to Sep 2026 covers early 2026 meetings where further easing is likely if the easing cycle continues. Market's 13.9% implies an unusually low chance of any cut in that window, which appears discounted relative to fundamental expectations.
evidence_points: Fed dot plot median projects fed funds rate of 3.1% by end-2026, down from 4.4% currently, implying multiple cuts.
CME FedWatch probabilities for mid-2026 show a non-negligible chance of cuts already priced in the futures curve.
Economic forecasts anticipate gradual easing in 2025-2026, raising the likelihood of at least one cut in H1 2026.
sources_consulted: Federal Reserve Summary of Economic Projections (Dec 2024)
